max_level: Every skill has 5 levels plus EVO (Skills page).
slots: Each run: 1 weapon + 5 other active skills, and 6 passive skills (Skills page). Skills reset at the start of each level.
count_note: 36 entries. The 'Drone (disambiguation)' page in the Skills category is excluded.

weapons.name: Katana
weapons.effect: Blade waves in front and behind the player; one of the two starting weapons.

weapons.name: Kunai
weapons.effect: Default weapon even when none is equipped; auto-targeting.

weapons.name: Lightchaser
weapons.effect: Sends blade waves out from the player; more waves with each star level.

weapons.name: Revolver
weapons.evo_effect: One more revolver and added damage; total bullet count 12.

weapons.name: Shotgun
weapons.effect: Attacks only in the facing direction; grade ladder below.
weapons.evo_effect: Fires at extremely high speed with a tighter spread; still fires in facing direction.

weapons.name: Void Power
weapons.effect: S grade weapon; fires auto-targeted black holes (area of effect).
weapons.evo_effect: Energy veils push enemies back and deal damage; veils do not block projectiles.

Void Power.note: base ATK '??'; grade skill text is a joke entry on the wiki

Void Power.grade_skill: Released black holes explode before fading

active_skills.name: Boomerang
active_skills.effect: Launches boomerangs that fly out and return.
active_skills.evo_effect: Fires two purple magnetic rebounders in a circle, damaging enemies in their path.

active_skills.name: Brick
active_skills.effect: Drops bricks above the player; knockback; limited durability.

active_skills.name: Drill Shot
active_skills.effect: Launches drills that bounce around the screen and pierce enemies.

active_skills.name: Durian
active_skills.effect: Launches a durian that bounces around the screen with knockback.

active_skills.name: Forcefield
active_skills.effect: Creates a damaging forcefield around the player.
active_skills.evo_effect: Slows enemies that come into contact.

active_skills.name: Guardian
active_skills.effect: Launches tops that rotate around the player and block enemy attacks (wiki text cut off).
active_skills.evo_effect: No longer has a limited duration.

active_skills.name: Laser Launcher
active_skills.effect: Fires lasers in a criss-cross pattern around the player; lasers remove poison patches.

active_skills.name: Lightning Emitter
active_skills.effect: Summons lightning bolts. Wiki calls it generally the best active (opinion).

active_skills.name: Medi-drone
active_skills.effect: Creates a healing zone that heals the player inside it.

active_skills.name: Modular Mine
active_skills.unlock: Earned at the start of Main Level 10 (page)
active_skills.combination: with Molotov -> Inferno Bomb; with Lightning Emitter -> Thunderbolt Bomb

active_skills.name: Molotov
active_skills.effect: Launches Molotovs that leave fire patches on the ground.
active_skills.evo_effect: Evolved form creates a ring around the player that slowly closes (Molotov page).

active_skills.name: RPG
active_skills.effect: Launches rockets that explode on impact.

active_skills.name: Soccer Ball
active_skills.evo_effect: More quantum balls spawn; damage and flight speed greatly increased. Base effect not captured.

active_skills.name: Type-A Drone
active_skills.effect: Launches small missiles in a clockwise circle from a drone.

active_skills.name: Type-B Drone
active_skills.effect: Launches rockets in a counter-clockwise circle from a drone.

passive_skills.name: Energy Cube
passive_skills.effect: Lowers the cooldown of all attack skills.

passive_skills.name: Exo-Bracer
passive_skills.effect: Increases the time skills stay active before resetting.

passive_skills.name: HE Fuel
passive_skills.effect: Increases size and range of skills.

passive_skills.name: Hi-Power Magnet
passive_skills.effect: Increases pickup range for EXP and items.
required_for: Sword of Disorder -> Sword of Domination

passive_skills.name: Oil Bond
passive_skills.effect: Increases the value of gold picked up.

passive_skills.name: Ronin Oyoroi
passive_skills.effect: Each upgrade reduces damage taken by 10%, max 50%.
